title: XDAO
tagline: XDAO - MultiChain DAO Ecosystem Built For Decentralized Future, XDAO is the fastest framework to create and manage decentralized autonomous organizations
description:
What is XDAO
⚡️XDAO was created with the idea to make DAOs the place for crypto mass adoption by providing the tools for groups to control mutual treasury, build communities and invest in DeFi.

In short, XDAO is a fully customizable DAO builder for treasury management, multisig wallet and the platform for investment. DAOs on XDAO can be any-sized companies.

📽 Product Intro
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QmCHALtuRmg

🔭 XDAO created specifically for:
– Venture funds
– Investment pools
– Startups
– DeFi projects
– NFT and GameFi collectors

🎯🎯🎯 What can be done with XDAO:
– Manage the treasury of the DeFi project
– Manage and distribute (salary, marketing, etc.) capital in any organization on the blockchain
– Invest in DeFi with shared assets
– Buy NFTs and collectively participate in GameFi
– Carry out charitable activities
– Participate jointly in allocations, IDO, Launchpad
– Manage family assets
– and much more!

Killer features:
– You can create a DAO in in 1 minute
– Hybrid voting system (less gas without sacrificing safety)
- Multi-token system (separate management rights and investment rights)
– XDAO Connect (interact with any DeFi Protocol directly from your DAO)
– Modular architecture (upgrade your DAO for any purposes)

Modules: 
– Private Exit module (Early burn of LP tokens)
– Dividends module (calculates dividend earnings per investor and allows to pay it)
– Launchpad module (creates initial Launchpad for crowdfunding)
– Payroll module (pay salaries to employees or other regular payments automatically)
– Document Sign module. Document signing is more important than ever for organizations, not only in Web2 but also in Web3. So we came up with the idea to implement this crucial element for companies of all sizes in Web3.

how_its_made:
All of us were independently involved in crypto world one way or another. Vladislav Shavlidze, our CEO, was the first one to come up with the idea of creating XDAO platform about two years ago. At that time, he was already experienced at working in finance and crypto industries and he saw that in the near future the market will be in need of tool for a fast and convenient way of creating organizations on a blockchain.

In 2019 Vladislav introduced his brother Zurab Shavlidze to the project and they formed the basis of the XDAO team. During their research they found that existing DAO builders were too complicated for an average user with no programming experience. Thus, they saw an opportunity to build a user-friendly platform that would be accessible to every user without a programming degree. 

It was a difficult technical task and to achieve it they invited Egor Gavrilov (CTO) to the team. Egor is a professional mathematician with extensive experience in DeFi development and is a founder of several other crypto projects. 

Soon after they started expanding, and they invited Anna Godovnikova (CMO) on board. Gradually our team was expanded with like-minded people who shared the same ideas and philosophy as the founders, and who wanted to change cryptocurrency world along with XDAO.
